The accused No.1 and 2 were generated bills for the items total worth of Rs.1,30,459/- they were scanned and hold the bill and taken the duplicate bill and given to the CW-4, 5 and 6 and the said items were sent to the out of the mall and thereby the accused persons have committed the criminal breach of trust and cheated the complainant and committed the above offences.

C.C.No.30237/2018 15. Point No.4: For the reasons stated and finding given to point Nos.1 to 3, the following is made.

ORDER The accused No.1 and 2 are not found guilty for the offences punishable under section 406,
408 and 420 read with section 34 of IPC.
Acting under section 248(1) of Code of Criminal Procedure the accused No.1 and 2 are hereby acquitted for the offences punishable under section 406, 408 and 420 read with section 34 of IPC.
The bail bonds and surety bonds executed by them stand canceled.
